src: APPSC Junior Assistant in Dr. NTR University of Health Scien
s: Under the Constitution of India, which of the following statements is correct about the Election Commission of India?
o: The Constitution of India empowers the Election Commission of India to allot symbols to parties.
The Election Commission of India has the authority to deregister a political party if it violates the provisions of the Representation of the People Act, 1951.
The Election Commission of India is empowered to determine the manner in which Lok Sabha seats are allotted to each state.
The Systematic Voters' Education and Electoral Participation (SVEEP) programme is the flagship initiative of the Election Commission of India aimed at increasing voter awareness and participation.
x: SVEEP (Systematic Voters' Education and Electoral Participation) is the ECI's flagship programme for voter awareness and participation. The ECI allots symbols under the Election Symbols Order, 1968, not by an express constitutional power; it cannot deregister a party for violating the RP Act (INC v Institute of Social Welfare, 2002); and seats per State are fixed by Parliament and the Delimitation Commission.

s: The initiative Mission Investigation@75 days, which mandates investigation officer to complete investigation of cases within 75 days of FIR registration is launched by which State Government?
x: Mission Investigation@75 Days was launched by Bihar Police from 1 January 2024: investigation, including the charge-sheet, must be finished within 75 days of the FIR (earlier the average was 261 days). Gujarat, Odisha and Uttar Pradesh are not linked to it.

s: " Every Indian is special. Every Indian is a VIP. " On which occasion did Prime Minister Narendra Modi tweet these words?
o: On abolition of red beacons on vehicles of dignitaries
x: On 19 April 2017 the Union Cabinet ended the use of red beacons (lal batti) on the vehicles of VIPs, keeping them only for emergency vehicles; Modi tweeted 'Every Indian is special. Every Indian is a VIP.' It had nothing to do with Yoga Day, BHIM or the UP campaign.

s: 'The Gazette of India' is a publication under the Ministry of
x: The Gazette of India is published by the Department of Publication under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (earlier Ministry of Urban Development) and printed by the Directorate of Printing; the e-Gazette is at egazette.gov.in.

s: On 10th April, 2017, Lok Sabha passed the Motor Vehicles Act (Amendment) Bill, 2016. Under the new provisions, government will develop a scheme for cashless treatment of road accident victims during ……… .
x: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2016 (passed by the Lok Sabha on 10 April 2017) provided for a scheme of cashless treatment of road-accident victims during the 'golden hour' – the first hour after a traumatic injury. Silver, platinum and diamond hour are not terms used.

s: English weekly newspaper of Publication Division of Govt. of India is
x: Employment News (Rozgar Samachar) is the weekly job newspaper published in English (and Hindi/Urdu) by the Publications Division, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. Mint is a private business daily; 'Evening Post' and 'Weekly India' are not its publications.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: In which of the following cities was the 'All India Conference of Directors General and Inspectors General of Police' held in December 2019?
x: The 54th All India Conference of DGsP/IGsP was held at IISER, Pune (Maharashtra) in December 2019, inaugurated by Home Minister Amit Shah on 6 December. Nashik, Bengaluru and Patna did not host it.

src: APPSC Assistant Social, BC & Tribal Welfare Officers Screeni
s: Which of the following Governments issued a guest control order with effect from 01/04/2017 restricting number of guests at a wedding?
x: The Jammu and Kashmir Guest Control Order (Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs dept.) applied from 1 April 2017 and capped guests – 500 at a daughter's wedding, 400 at a son's, 100 at engagements. Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Haryana issued no such order.

s:
Consider the following statements about "National War Memorial":

I. It was inaugurated in 2021.

II. The eternal flame of Amar Jawan Jyoti underneath India Gate was put out and merged with another eternal flame at the National War Memorial.

III. It was built to commemorate all the soldiers who have laid down their lives in the various battles, wars, operations and conflicts of Independent India.

IV. The architecture of the memorial is based on four concentric circles.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: Statement I is wrong: the National War Memorial was dedicated on 25 February 2019, not in 2021. II is right (the Amar Jawan Jyoti flame was merged with the memorial's flame in January 2022), III is right (it honours soldiers who died after Independence) and IV is right (four concentric circles – Amar, Veerta, Tyag, Rakshak Chakra), so the answer is II, III and IV only.

src: APPSC AE (Subordinate Services) Mains General Studies & Ment
s: Crores of people formed a human chain in Bihar in January, 2017 to show resolve on?
x: On 21 January 2017 Bihar formed a human chain of about 11,000 km, joined by crores of people, in support of prohibition of liquor (in force in Bihar since April 2016). It was not about terrorism, tobacco or caste discrimination.

src: APPSC Dental Asst. Surgeons, Zilla Sainik Welfare Officers,
s: For how many assembly seats elections are currently underway in 5 States?
x: The five States that polled together (2017, and again 2022) – Uttar Pradesh 403, Punjab 117, Uttarakhand 70, Manipur 60 and Goa 40 – have 403+117+70+60+40 = 690 Assembly seats; 620, 650 and 670 do not add up.

s: Union Home Ministry (MHA) approved Uttar Pradesh government's proposal to rename Allahabad as ____, on 1st January 2019, ahead of 'Kumbh Mela 2019'?
x: The MHA approved Uttar Pradesh's proposal to rename Allahabad as Prayagraj ahead of the Kumbh Mela 2019 (the UP Cabinet had approved the change in October 2018).

s: Which of these metal was banned to be used in firecrackers by the Supreme Court in National Capital Region and all other parts of India ahead of Diwali in November 2023?
x: In November 2023 the Supreme Court clarified that its order banning barium (barium salts/nitrate) in firecrackers applies across India, not only Delhi-NCR. Boron, chromium and strontium were not the subject of that ban.

s: When was the Supreme Court stayed the implementation of the three controversial Farm Laws?
x: The Supreme Court stayed the implementation of the three farm laws on 12 January 2021 and set up an expert committee; Parliament repealed the laws in November–December 2021.
